shading: Opaque Default Lit, one-sided; no Nanite, no collision, no vertex colors, no CPD dependencies

UV0.mapping: Unique planar face islands with 3px gutters at each slot resolution. LOD1 reuses existing islands.

UV1.name: SurfaceDetail
UV1.purpose: Tiled Debris normal and DetailColor, 0.5 metre repeat; not a FinishBake or lightmap

normal: DirectX tangent-space; UE normal map compression; sRGB false; do not flip green in Unreal

Debris.UV0: Unique planar polygon islands, 3 pixel gutters; no tiling or overlaps.
Debris.DetailColor: Linear tiled aggregate multiplier on UV1; lerp(1, DetailColor.rgb, 0.65) * UV0 BaseColor

Scorch.UV0: Unique planar polygon islands, 3 pixel gutters; no tiling or overlaps.

Embers.UV0: Unique planar polygon islands, 3 pixel gutters; no tiling or overlaps.

mipmaps: Keep generated mipmaps; at most 2048 per slot. NeverStream=true, following project building texture residency policy.

Debris.BaseColor: BaseColor texture RGB on UV0 * lerp(1, DetailColor RGB on UV1, 0.65)
Debris.Normal: texture RGB sampled with TexCoord index 1, strength 0.85

LOD.simplification: Fracture face relief and small corner chips simplified; small tubes 3-sided instead of 4-sided. All pieces retained. Mound shells and wall profiles exact; compare switch renders.
